notes.title: Galactic Tavern "Coming Soon" Page Announcement!
notes.notes:
It's time to explore Galactic Tavern! 🚀 Let's meet at the most exciting tavern in the universe. Add it to your wishlist and support us!

Embark on a cosmic journey as you build and manage your space tavern! Discover exotic ingredients, craft unique cocktails, and create a bustling atmosphere with live music performances. Explore the depths of space and become the ultimate entrepreneur in this management simulation adventure!

notes.title: Hexoria "Coming Soon" Page Announcement!
notes.notes:
🔥 Exciting news for all strategy game fans! 🔥 

We're thrilled to announce that our upcoming turn-based roguelike deckbuilder game, Hexoria, now has a "Coming Soon" page on Steam!

Harness the power of magical cards, build and expand your village, gather resources, and use your cards to gain obedience in this thrilling adventure. 🧙‍♀️🃏🏡⚒️🔮
